subject: Hybrid consumption licensing and onboarding retainer — initial commercial questions
messages:
From: Laura Meyers <laura.meyers@pivotalhealth.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@pivotalhealth.com
Date: 2026-09-20T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Inquiry: hybrid consumption + onboarding retainer options

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood for our clinical summarization workloads. Procurement asked me to consolidate a few commercial questions before we loop legal:

- Can you outline how a hybrid consumption license would work if we combine metered usage for dev/test plus a committed node pool for peak traffic? Specifically: how is the platform fee amortized across consumption vs. committed nodes?
- We have a one-time onboarding program (SRE + security review). Can you confirm an estimated onboarding retainer and whether that can be credited against the first invoice?
- During seasonal peaks we anticipate a 2–3x spike. Do you offer 'surge credits' or short-term burst pricing rather than forcing a permanent commit?
- What does the support tier mapping look like for enterprise customers on private VPC deployments? We need 24x7 oncall with 1-hour P1 response and a named escalation path.
- Finally, our audit/compliance team cares about audit log retention and access to raw request logs for SOC reviews — is 1 year retention available on Private with KMS-backed logs?

If you can send a short note and an indicative term sheet, we’ll try to resolve commercial questions before legal jumps in.

Thanks,
Laura Meyers
VP Procurement, Pivotal Health
laura.meyers@pivotalhealth.com

---
Pivotal Health (external)
From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Inquiry: hybrid consumption + onboarding retainer options

Hi Laura — appreciate the clear list. High level answers below; attaching a lightweight term sheet for the hybrid structure. Ben and Irene have added specific numbers.

- Hybrid consumption model: customer holds a committed node pool (reserved nodes) for baseline capacity and a metered bucket for burst/Dev usage. Platform fee is billed monthly and can be split: a fixed portion tied to reserved nodes (amortized over contract term) and a variable component that scales with metered tokens. We can show two amortization approaches: fully amortized vs. base+variable. See term sheet attached.
- Onboarding retainer: typical range is $45k–$95k depending on scope. We can credit up to 50% of the retainer against the first 3 months of platform fees for a 12+ month commit. SOW estimate attached.
- Surge / burst handling: we offer temporary burst capacity (short-term reservations) and a surge credit pool for a limited number of peak events per year. This avoids forcing a permanent additional commit. We can scope a 60-day burst window and pre-purchase surge credits at a discounted rate.
- Support tiers: Privacy deployments are eligible for Enterprise SRE (24x7) or Premier SRE. For your ask (1-hour P1), that maps to Enterprise SRE + Named SME with an optional SRE retainer. We’ll outline the tiers and response SLAs in Ben's note.
- Audit logs / retention: Private deployment supports KMS-backed logs. We can do 12 months retention behind customer-controlled KMS; longer retention is available as an add-on.

Irene will attach the term sheet and the onboarding SOW estimate. Ben will follow with price scenarios. Happy to jump on a 30-min call if that helps.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Commercial, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com

Subject: RE: Inquiry: hybrid consumption + onboarding retainer options

Hi Laura — quick pricing scenarios to make this concrete. Numbers are indicative until legal/finance sign off.

Scenario A — Minimal commit (12 months):
- Reserved pool: 4 reserved nodes (baseline)
- Platform fee: $24k/month fixed (amortized fully across term) + $0.0009/token variable on metered consumption
- Onboarding retainer: $60k (50% creditable against first 3 months platform fees)
- Surge credits: pre-purchase 200k token credits at 30% discount usable in 60-day windows (up to 4 windows/year)

Scenario B — Higher commit (24 months, lower unit cost):
- Reserved pool: 8 reserved nodes
- Platform fee: $40k/month fixed (lower variable rate) + $0.0006/token
- Onboarding retainer: $45k (75% creditable)
- Surge credits: 500k token pool at 40% discount, plus one free short-term reservation up to 30 days/year

Notes:
- We can convert platform fee amortization to a single amortized upfront charge if preferred for CAPEX treatment.
- All support / SRE retainers are priced separately and can be purchased as monthly or annual addons.

If either scenario looks in-range I can produce a simple pricing appendix and a short amendment to the attached term sheet.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

Laura — attaching a cleaned term sheet with our recommended support mapping and the SOW estimate. Key clarifications:

- Support mapping: Enterprise SRE provides 24x7 P1 with 1-hour initial response, named escalation manager, monthly operational reviews, and a quarterly incident RCA cadence. Premier SRE adds runbook co-development and quarterly on-site health checks.
- Onboarding scope: standard SRE onboarding (4 weeks), security review (3 weeks), and optional performance tuning (2 weeks). The SOW spreadsheet breaks this into line items.
- Surge credits: can be drawn down programmatically and appear on the portal. Unused credits roll for 12 months. For auditability, usage reports are exportable and signed with timestamps for SOC reviews.
- Billing: platform fee split is documented on p2 of the term sheet: 60% fixed (reserved node amortization) / 40% variable by default; we can adjust to 50/50 if Pivotal prefers.

I’ve updated Redwood_Hybrid_License_TermSheet_v2.pdf with the 50/50 amortization table and included an example invoice.

Irene Choi
